title: Rook Takes Queen
setup: Your queen on f2 looks up an empty f-file at the black pawn on f7 and the king standing behind it.
hint: The black queen is guarded once, by a pawn. What is your own queen doing to that pawn from f2?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxe6}} wins the queen for a rook. The f7-pawn is its only defender, and it is pinned to the king on **f8** by your queen on **f2**. Every square between them is empty, so the recapture is illegal and the queen is gone.
